revenue.source: Apple FY2026 Form 10-K (FYE Sep 26, 2026), income statement: total net sales

operating_income.source: Apple FY2026 Form 10-K income statement (via stocktitan summary of 10-K, and stock-analysis-on.net); FY2024/25 match edgar.tools

d_and_a.source: Apple FY2026 Form 10-K cash flow statement: depreciation and amortization

capex.source: Apple FY2026 Form 10-K cash flow statement: payments for acquisition of PP&E (sign flipped to positive)

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 growth was 15% (FY2025 6%, FY2024 2%), judged above trend; fade from 8% to 4%, converging toward terminal growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2026 margin 33.0% (158,063/478,834), FY2025 32.0%, FY2024 31.5%; set at 32%, a slight haircut to FY2026 peak for mean reversion.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. Apple effective rate in recent years (mid-to-high teens); 21% US statutory rate offset by foreign mix. Not verified against the 10-K tax note.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: 3-yr historical average D&A/revenue (2.9%, 2.8%, 2.8%) from 10-K figures above.

wacc.source: Assumption: cost of equity ~9% (rf ~4.2% + beta ~1.1-1.2 x ERP ~4.5-5%); debt only ~3% of capital so WACC≈cost of equity. Not sourced from a data provider.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal GDP/inflation-ish growth, below the risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: Apple FY2026 10-K: term debt 78,114 (total, current+non-current) + commercial paper 1,997 (stocktitan 10-K summary) = 80,111, less cash 36,305 and current marketable securities 20,417 (10-K balance sheet) = 56,722. Excludes leases and non-current marketable securities (~80.2bn; total cash+securities 136,935), per the stated convention; the reviewer may want to include them.

diluted_shares.source: Apple FY2026 10-K: weighted-average diluted shares 14,720,306 thousand = 14,720.306 million
